sql_log.purpose: Test matched adjacent revisions and direct-request/run decomposition.
sql_log.sql:
with pairs as (
 select a.id a_id,b.id b_id
 from programacion.input_readiness_runs a
 join programacion.input_readiness_runs b
   on b.contract_revision='5.13.1'
  and a.pantalla_id=b.pantalla_id
  and a.source_snapshot_sha256=b.source_snapshot_sha256
 where a.contract_revision='5.13'
   and a.created_at<timestamptz '2026-10-15'
   and b.created_at<timestamptz '2026-10-15'
), req as (
 select q.*,extract(epoch from(q.finished_at-q.requested_at))*1000.0 request_ms,
        r.curator_duration_ms,r.validator_duration_ms
 from programacion.ig_direct_requests_v1 q
 left join programacion.input_readiness_runs r on r.id=q.last_run_id
 where q.requested_at<timestamptz '2026-10-15'
)
select
 (select count(*) from pairs) exact_adjacent_revision_pairs,
 (select count(*) from req) direct_requests,
 (select count(*) from req where finished_at is not null) finished_requests,
 (select count(distinct last_run_id) from req) distinct_last_runs,
 (select percentile_cont(.5) within group(order by request_ms) from req where request_ms>0) request_p50_ms,
 (select percentile_cont(.9) within group(order by request_ms) from req where request_ms>0) request_p90_ms,
 (select count(*) from req where request_ms-curator_duration_ms-validator_duration_ms<0) negative_residual_rows,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('request_id',id,'run_id',last_run_id,'request_ms',request_ms,'curator_ms',curator_duration_ms,'validator_ms',validator_duration_ms,'residual_ms',request_ms-curator_duration_ms-validator_duration_ms) order by id) from req) request_rows

sql_log.purpose: Test whether validator stage components form an additive decomposition.

with t as (
 select *,coalesce(classification_ms,0)+coalesce(assertions_ms,0)+coalesce(ekb_ms,0)+
 coalesce(gap_proposals_ms,0)+coalesce(db_write_ms,0)+coalesce(wait_resume_ms,0) component_sum
 from programacion.input_validator_chunk_timings
 where created_at<timestamptz '2026-10-15'
)
select count(*) chunks,count(distinct run_id) runs,
 sum(duration_ms) duration_sum_ms,
 sum(classification_ms) classification_sum_ms,
 sum(assertions_ms) assertions_sum_ms,
 sum(ekb_ms) ekb_sum_ms,
 sum(gap_proposals_ms) gap_sum_ms,
 sum(db_write_ms) db_write_sum_ms,
 sum(wait_resume_ms) wait_resume_sum_ms,
 count(*) filter(where component_sum>duration_ms) component_sum_gt_duration,
 count(*) filter(where duration_ms is null or duration_ms=0) duration_null_or_zero
from t
